about: The king comes in before the Ark, bows, and prays: God lifts the poor and tests hearts, so may Zion be a savior in every place and for every creature, lead her people, and rise against their enemies. Then he circles her and praises her as a bride. The narrator says the spirit of prophecy was on him, as on Peter and John at Tabor.

sentences.i: Chapter 54: Where David prophesied and greeted Zion
sentences.n: Chapter heading; ፶፬ is 54 (፶ = 50, ፬ = 4). ኀበ here opens a title-phrase, 'where / the place in which' (the same word elsewhere is 'with, at'; this reading of the heading is a little loose, ?). ተነበየ is the T-stem of ነበየ, 'prophesied'. ወተሰለማ is ወ- 'and' + ተሰለመ 'greeted, did homage' + the object ሃ 'her', which is then repeated by ለጽዮን 'to Zion' (ለ- marks the person greeted, and doubles the suffix). Zion is the Ark (ታቦት) throughout. 'David' is the throne-name of Menelik, son of Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, taken when he was anointed in Jerusalem (see unit 40).

sentences.l: And-entered king and-stood before-her and-greeted-her and-bowed to-her and-said:
sentences.i: And the king went in and stood before her, and greeted her and bowed down to her, and said:
sentences.n: Narrative verbs in the perfect, each with ወ- 'and': ቦአ 'entered', ቆመ 'stood', ተሰለማ 'greeted her' (ተሰለመ + ሃ, as in the heading), ሰገደ 'bowed down' (ሰገደ ላቲ, where ላቲ is ለ- with the 3rd feminine suffix, 'to her'), ይቤ 'said' (an irregular perfect that regularly introduces speech). ቅድሜሃ 'before her' = ቅድሜ + ሃ. 'Her' is Zion, the Ark, which the king addresses as a person. ፤ marks the pause before the prayer.

sentences.i: O Lord, God of Israel, to you be glory, for you do your will and not the will of man.
sentences.n: እግዚኦ is the vocative 'O Lord' (the -ኦ ending); አምላከ እስራኤል is a construct chain, 'God-of Israel' (the final -ä of አምላከ marks the construct). ለከ 'to you' = ለ- + ከ. ስብሐት 'praise, glory' is left without a verb, a wish: 'to you (be) glory'. እስመ 'because, for' begins a reason clause that runs through the next several units. ትገብር is a 2nd-person masculine singular imperfect (ተ-), 'you do'; ፈቃደከ 'your will' carries the accusative -ä. ወአኮ is 'and not' (አኮ negates a noun or phrase).

sentences.l: You-bring-to-ruin-him his-wisdom to-the-wise and-you-make-foolish-him counsel-of to-the-counselor and-you-lift-out-him to-the-poor from dung and-you-set-them on rock firm for-his-feet;
sentences.i: You bring the wise man's wisdom to ruin, and make the counselor's counsel foolish, and lift the poor out of the dung and set them on a firm rock for their feet.
sentences.n: A cluster of prophetic echoes: 1 Samuel 2:8 and Psalm 113:7 (the poor raised from the dust and the dunghill), Isaiah 29:14 and 1 Corinthians 1:19-20 (the wisdom of the wise destroyed), Psalm 40:2 (feet set on a rock). Grammar: ታረስዖ ጥበቦ ለጠቢብ, 'you ruin his wisdom, the wise man's', uses the anticipatory suffix: ጥበቦ is ጥበብ + ዎ 'his' (accusative), ለጠቢብ names the owner, and the verb itself carries a doubling suffix -ዖ (-ዎ) that looks ahead to the object; this is a common Geʿez way of saying 'the wise man's wisdom' (ታረስዖ is a causative of ረስዐ 'be spoiled, rot'; ?). ታአብዶ is the causative 'make foolish', again with -ዎ; ምክረ ለመካሪ 'the counselor's counsel' is the construct ምክረ followed by ለ- naming the owner (no suffix on the noun this time). ትሜጥቆ 'you draw out, lift' (?, the stem is obscure to me; ትሜጥቅ + ዎ 'him', doubling ለነዳይ); ሠርም 'dung'. ታቀውሞን 'you set them upright' (2nd masc. imperfect of the causative አቆመ, with ሞን 'them'). ሰኰናሁ is 'his sole/hoof', the singular suffix -ሁ being collective for the poor (ነዳይ), so 'their feet' in English.

sentences.l: And-as-for-us salvation-our it-goes-out from-Zion and-it-takes-away sin from-people-his and-is-poured-out goodness and-mercy in all world;
sentences.i: But as for us, our salvation goes out from Zion, and takes sin away from his people, and goodness and mercy are poured out into all the world.
sentences.n: Cf. Psalm 14:7 ('salvation of Israel out of Zion') and Isaiah 2:3. ወለነሰ is ወ- + ለነ 'to us' + the particle -ሰ 'but, as for': 'and as for us'. መድኀኒትነ 'our salvation' (መድኀኒት + ነ). The verb ይወፅእ is masculine 'it goes out', the subject being salvation. ያአትት 'removes' (the causative አአተተ of the published parts; the root is not well known). ይትከዐው is the passive-reflexive of ከዐወ 'pour out'. Here the people are God's (ሕዝቡ 'his people', ሕዝብ + ሁ). The Kebra's theology: salvation reaches the whole world from Zion, i.e. the Ark.

sentences.i: For we too are the work of his hands. Who will reproach (?) him if he loves us as he loved Israel, his people? And who will hold (?) him back if he raises us up into the heavens, his throne?
sentences.n: The edition prints እደዊሁንሕነ as one word: እደዊሁ 'his hands' + ንሕነ 'we', so 'we are the work of his hands' (ንሕነሂ 'we also' earlier in the clause makes the repeated ንሕነ emphatic). ተግባረ 'work, deed' is the construct 'work of' before እደዊሁ, here the predicate. Two rhetorical questions with መኑ 'who?'; ለእመ 'if'. The verbs are hard: ይትዔየሮ 'will reproach him' (a tä-stem, root perhaps ዐየረ 'blame'; ?) and ይግእዞ 'will hold him back, constrain him' (?, the stem is uncertain; the parallel with the first question guides me). አፍቀረነ 'he loved us' (perfect + object ነ); ከመ እስረኤል is a spelling of 'Israel' (the edition has እስረኤል for እስራኤል). አዕረገነ 'he raised us up' (causative of ዐርገ 'ascend'). Heaven as God's throne: Isaiah 66:1. The point: the Ethiopians are brought into the people of God like Israel.

sentences.i: Do not be dismayed (?), or slack (?), or angry at the multitude of our sins, for we are a people without law, who have not learned your praises.
sentences.n: A string of three negative commands (ኢ- + the feminine 2nd person imperfect). ኢትትአንተሊ and ኢትትሀየዪ are uncertain (?): the stems are reflexive and I can't confirm them in Dillmann; ተሀየየ is possibly 'be slack, negligent' and the first something like 'be wearied, dismayed'. ኢትትቈጥዒ is from ተቈጥዐ 'be angry' (ቍጥዓ 'anger'). በብዝኀ is በ- + ብዝኀ (construct) 'in the multitude of'. ዘአልቦ ሕገ 'who has no law': ዘ- 'who' + አልቦ 'there is not to him' (a common idiom). ዘኢተምህረ 'who has not learned' (ተምህረ, the passive/reflexive of መሀረ 'teach'); the people addressed are the Ethiopians, who were not given the Law as Israel was. ሰብሖተኪ 'your praises'.

sentences.i: And from now on, guide us and teach us, give us understanding and make us wise, so that we may learn your praises, and so that your name may be praised over us at every time and on all days, in every day and every night, in every hour and through all the length of the times.
sentences.n: ወእምይእዜሰ is ወ- + እም- 'from' + ይእዜ 'now' + -ሰ 'indeed, then'. Four imperatives with ነ 'us' (all in the masculine form, ምርሕ-, መሀር-, አለብው-, አጥብብ-, though Zion has been addressed in the feminine; the speaker may be slipping into address to God, or the edition's forms are loose, ?): ምርሐነ (of መርሐ 'lead'), መሀረነ ('teach'), ወአለብወነ (causative of ለበወ, 'make understand', ልብ 'mind'), ወአጥብበነ (causative of ጠበበ, 'make wise'; ጥበብ 'wisdom'). ከመ 'so that' takes the subjunctive ንትመሀር 'we may learn' and the passive ይሰባሕ 'may be praised' (ስምኪ 'your name'). በላዕሌነ 'upon us' (ላዕለ + ነ). The long list of time words (ጊዜ, መዋዕል 'days', መዐልት 'day', ሌሊት 'night', ሰዐት 'hour') ends with ኑኀ አዝማን, 'length of times' (ኑኀ is the construct of ኑኅ 'length'), i.e. forever.

sentences.i: Arise, Zion, and put on your strength, and overcome your enemies, and give us firmness for your kings (?). Put to shame those who hate you, and make glad those who love you.
sentences.n: Cf. Isaiah 52:1 ('Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion') and Psalm 132:8 ('Arise, Lord, into your resting place, you and the ark of your strength'). Five feminine imperatives: ተንሥኢ ('arise'), ልበሲ ('put on'), ሙኢዮሙ ('overcome them', ሞአ with ዮሙ 'them'), አስተኀፍርዮሙ and አስተፈሥሒዮሙ (causatives 'shame' and 'gladden', each with ዮሙ). The edition has a stray wordspace in ወ ፡ ሀብነ; the text is kept as given. ሀብነ ጽንዐ ለነገሥትኪ is awkward (?): literally 'give-us firmness to-your-kings'; the ነ may be a stray, in which case 'give your kings firmness'. I read it as above. The ፨ marks the end of the prayer.

sentences.i: Then he went around her and said: Here is Zion! Here is the savior! Here is she who gives joy! Here is she who shines like the sun! Here is she who is adorned with glory! Here is she who is adorned like a bride, not in garments of passing glory, but adorned with glory and praise from God.
sentences.n: ዖዳ is ዖደ 'go around, encircle' + ሃ 'her' (reading mine; he circles the Ark as David danced before it in 2 Samuel 6:14). ነያ is 'behold her' (an interjection built on the 3rd feminine ending, repeated for emphasis). The adjectives are feminine: መስተፈሥሒት 'she who gives joy' (the feminine agent noun of the causative-reflexive አስተፈሥሐ 'gladden'), ብርህት 'bright, shining', ስርጉት 'adorned'. Cf. Song of Songs 6:10 ('bright as the sun') and Isaiah 61:10, Revelation 21:2 (a bride adorned). አኮ በአልባሰ ክብር ኀላፊ: አልባሰ is the construct of አልባስ 'garments', ክብር 'glory, honor', ኀላፊ 'passing, transient'; the garments are of the earthly kind and the glory is from God. አላ 'but'. ስብሐት 'praise, glory'.

sentences.i: She whom they look upon is worthy, and not she whom they forsake; she whom they esteem (?) is worthy, and not she whom they despise; she whom they love is worthy, and not she whom they hate; she whom they draw near to is worthy, and not she from whom they stand far off.
sentences.n: A very difficult passage (?). እንተ is the feminine relative 'she who, that which'; with the plural verb it must be 'she whom (they look at)', Zion being the antecedent. Alternatively 'that which' would give 'what they look upon is worthy'. መፍትው 'fitting, worthy'. The verbs: ይኔጽሩ 'they look' (ነጸረ), የኀድጉ 'they leave' (ኀደገ), ያበድሩ (?, perhaps 'they esteem, favor'; I cannot confirm the root), ይሜንኑ 'they despise, renounce' (መነነ), ያፈቅሩ 'love', ይጸልኡ 'hate', ይቀርቡ 'draw near' (እንተይቀርቡ is run together in the edition), ይርሕቁ 'are far'. The four pairs set love against hatred and nearness against distance. I take the sense to be that Zion is worthy of the people's love and nearness; the detail is uncertain.

(feminine imperative of ሰምዐ), ገዓረነ 'our cry' (ገዓር + ነ, accusative). ተግሕሦ is read as 'turning away' (?). እስከ ይመጽእ እግዚእኪ ወይነግሥ ላዕሌኪ: the Lord (here God, or the Messiah) 'comes and reigns over you', an expectation of the Lord's coming to Zion; cf. Zechariah 14:9.

sentences.n: ማኅደሩ አንቲ ለአምላከ ሰማይ: ማኅደሩ is ማኅደር 'dwelling' + ሁ 'his', again an anticipatory suffix with ለ- giving the owner, so 'you are his dwelling, the God of heaven's'. አምላከ ሰማይ is a construct chain, 'God-of heaven'. The Ark is God's dwelling-place on earth, the central theology of the book.

sentences.l: This he-spoke David king son-of Solomon king-of Israel for it-came-down upon-him spirit-of prophecy because-of joy-his and-not-he-knew what he-says like Peter and-John on-top-of mountain-of Tabor;
sentences.i: David the king, the son of Solomon, king of Israel, spoke this, for the spirit of prophecy came down on him because of his joy, and he did not know what he was saying, as Peter and John did on the top of Mount Tabor.
sentences.n: The narrator steps in. ዘንተ is the accusative of ዝንቱ 'this'. ዳዊት ንጉሥ ወልደ ሰሎሞን ንጉሠ እስራኤል: 'David king, son of Solomon, king of Israel' (ንጉሠ is the construct of ንጉሥ before እስራኤል). This is Menelik under his throne-name. መንፈሰ ትንቢት 'spirit of prophecy' (construct, 'spirit-of prophecy'). ኢያአምር 'he did not know' (the imperfect used as a past 'did not know'). ዘይነብብ 'what he says' (ነበበ). The comparison is to Peter and John (the text names two; the Gospels name Peter, James and John) at the Transfiguration, when Peter did not know what he said (Luke 9:33). ደብረ ታቦር is Mount Tabor, the traditional site of the Transfiguration.

sentences.l: And-marveled-at-him all-of-them and-said this son-of prophet among prophets-(question) counted
sentences.i: And they all marveled at him and said, 'This is a prophet's son. Is he counted among the prophets?'
sentences.n: Cf. 1 Samuel 10:11-12 and 19:24, where the onlookers ask 'Is Saul also among the prophets?' ወአንከርዎ is አንከረ 'marvel at' + ዎ 'him' (the causative stem, which with the object means 'be amazed by'). ኵሎሙ 'all of them'. ወይቤሉ 'and they said'. ውስተ ነቢያትኑ: ኑ is the question enclitic 'is it so?' (here 'among the prophets?'). ኍሉቅ is 'counted' (the passive participle of ኈለቈ 'count'). The edition ends with a double ፨ ፨, the closing marker of the section; it is kept as part of the last unit.

glossary.እምሕዝቡ: ሕዝብ — from his people (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምኀቤሁ: ኀበ — from him, from his side (እም- 'from' + ኀቤ- + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"'
glossary.እስረኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; variant spelling እስረኤል)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?)
glossary.እንተይቀርቡ: ቀርበ — which (f.) they approach (እንተ 'which, fem.' run together with 3mp imperfect ይቀርቡ of ቀርበ 'draw near')
glossary.እደዊሁንሕነ: እድ — his hands (plural እደው, form እደዊ- + -ሁ '3ms his'), run together with ንሕነ 'we' (እደዊሁ + ንሕነ written as one word) (?)
glossary.እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኩንነ: ኮነ — be to us! (2fs imperative + -ነ '1cp to us')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወ: ወ — and (conjunction, written as a separate word before ይቤሉ) · also a separate word before በደኃሪ ባሕር ('and in the last sea')
glossary.ወለመኳንንት: መኰንን — and for the governors, rulers (ወ- + ለ- + plural መኳንንት)
glossary.ወለነሰ: ለ — and as for us (ወ- + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወለነገደ: ነገድ — and for the tribes of (ወ- + ለ- + noun, construct 'tribe(s) of')
glossary.ወለአህጉርኒ: ሀገር — and for the cities too (ወ- + ለ- + plural አህጉር + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወለአራዊት: አርዌ — and for the wild beasts (ወ- + ለ- + plural አራዊት)
glossary.ወለእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and for cattle, domestic animals (ወ- + ለ- + collective noun)
glossary.ወለጽገያት: ጽጌ — and for the flowers (ወ- + ለ- + plural ጽገያት of ጽጌ) (?)
glossary.ወለፍረያት: ፍሬ — and for the fruits (ወ- + ለ- + plural ፍረያት)
glossary.ወልበሲ: ለበሰ — and put on! (ወ- + 2fs imperative, G, l-b-s)
glossary.ወመሀረነ: መሀረ — and teach us (ወ- + imperative of መሀረ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወመሐሪ: መሐሪ — and merciful (ወ- + adjective/agent noun of መሐረ; with imperative force, 'be merciful') (?)
glossary.ወሙኢዮሙ: ሞአ — and overcome them (ወ- + 2fs imperative of ሞአ + -ዮሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
glossary.ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወስምዒ: ሰምዐ — and hear! (ወ- + 2fs imperative, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወቆመ: ቆመ — and he stood (ወ- + 3ms perfect, q-w-m)
glossary.ወበሕይወትኒ: ሕይወት — and in life too (ወ- + በ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወበስብሐት: ስብሐት — and in glory, in praise (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበቀላያት: ቀላይ — and in the deeps (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ቀላያት)
glossary.ወበአውግርኒ: አውግር — and in the hills too (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun አውግር, meaning uncertain, + enclitic -ኒ) (?)
glossary.ወበከሐክኒ: ከሐክ — and in the parched ground too (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun ከሐክ, meaning uncertain, + enclitic -ኒ) (?)
glossary.ወበኵሉ: ኵሉ — and in all, in every (ወ- + በ- + quantifier)
glossary.ወበየብስኒ: የብስ — and on dry land too (ወ- + በ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወበገዳምኒ: ገዳም — and in the wilderness too (ወ- + በ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወበፀአትኪ: ፀአት — and at your going out (ወ- + በ- + verbal noun ፀአት of ወፅአ + -ኪ '2fs your')
glossary.ወበፅሙናኒ: ፅሙና — and in solitary places (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun ፅሙና, meaning uncertain, perhaps 'solitude, hidden places'; + enclitic -ኒ) (?)
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተሰለማ: ተሰለመ — and he greeted her, did homage to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem, + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወታቀውሞን: አቆመ — and you set them (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, causative of ቆመ 'stand', + -ሞን '3mp them')
glossary.ወታአብዶ: አአበደ — and you make foolish (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, causative of አበደ 'be foolish'; + -ዎ '3ms', doubling the object)
glossary.ወትሜጥቆ: መጠቀ — and you lift out, draw out (ወ- + 2ms imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; the lemma is conjectural, inferred from the form, and the stem is not well known) (?)
glossary.ወንተሉ: ተልወ — and we shall follow (ወ- + 1cp subjunctive, G, t-l-w)
glossary.ወንከውነኪ: ኮነ — and we shall be to you (ወ- + 1cp subjunctive + -ኪ '2fs to you')
glossary.ወአለብወነ: አለበወ — and give us understanding (ወ- + imperative, causative of ለበወ 'understand', + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአስተኀፍርዮሙ: አስተኀፈረ — and put them to shame (ወ- + 2fs imperative, causative-reflexive of ኀፈረ, + -ዮሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወአስተፈሥሒዮሙ: አስተፈሥሐ — and make them glad (ወ- + 2fs imperative + -ዮሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወአንቲኒ: አንቲ — and you also (ወ- + 2fs independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአንከርዎ: አንከረ — and they marveled at him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative-type stem, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአጥብበነ: አጥበበ — and make us wise (ወ- + imperative, causative of ጠበበ 'be wise', + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወኢታድኅፅነ: አድኅፀ — and do not abandon us (?) (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms jussive, causative + -ነ '1cp us'; the root is uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወኢትርሐቅነ: ርሕቀ — and do not go far from us (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms jussive + -ነ '1cp us'; the form is masculine, Zion is otherwise feminine) (?)
glossary.ወኢትትሀየዪ: ተሀየየ — and do not be slack (?) (ወ- + ኢ- + 2fs jussive, tä-stem; the stem is not well known) (?)
glossary.ወኢትትቈጥዒ: ተቈጥዐ — and do not be angry (ወ- + ኢ- + 2fs jussive, tä-stem of ቈጥዐ)
glossary.ወኢትጸመምነ: ጸመመ — and do not be deaf to us (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms jussive of ጸመመ 'be deaf' + -ነ '1cp to us')
glossary.ወኢትፍቅዲ: ፈቀደ — and do not wish, do not choose (ወ- + ኢ- + 2fs jussive, G, f-q-d)
glossary.ወኢያአምር: አእመረ — and he did not know (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect of አእመረ 'know')
glossary.ወእምኀበኒ: ኀበ — and from wherever (ወ- + እም- 'from' + ኀበ 'where' + -ኒ 'ever, also')
glossary.ወእምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — and from now on, indeed (ወ- + እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this')
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወኵልያት: ኵልያ — and kidneys (ወ- + noun, plural ኵልያት)
glossary.ወያበዝኅ: አበዝኀ — and he multiplies (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of በዝኀ 'be many')
glossary.ወያአትት: አአተተ — and he removes, takes away (ወ- + 3ms imperfect; the stem is not well known)
glossary.ወይመቊስ: መቈሰ — and he wounds (ወ- + 3ms imperfect; the stem is not well known) (?)
glossary.ወይምሑ: መሐወ — and he uproots, wipes out (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ḥ-w; the sense 'uproot' is from the context) (?)
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይትከዐው: ተከዐወ — and is poured out (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ከዐወ 'pour', k-ʿ-w)
glossary.ወይነሥት: ነሠተ — and he tears down, pulls down (ወ- + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ወይነሥእ: ነሥአ — and he takes (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወይነግሥ: ነግሠ — and he reigns (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, n-g-ś)
glossary.ወጽዋዐ: ጽዋዕ — and a cup (ወ- + noun, construct 'cup of')
glossary.ወፃእኪ: ወፅአ — you went out (2fs perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ; the first ወ is a root letter, not 'and')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዖዳ: ዖደ — he went around her (3ms perfect + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
glossary.ዘኢተምህረ: መሀረ — who has not been taught, has not learned (ዘ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem ተምህረ of መሀረ 'teach')
glossary.ዘይነብብ: ነበበ — what he says (ዘ- 'what, which' + 3ms imperfect, G, n-b-b)
glossary.የኀድጉ: ኀደገ — they leave, forsake (3mp imperfect, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ያሤኒ: አሠነየ — he make good, adorn (3ms jussive, causative of ሠነየ)
glossary.ያበድሩ: አበደረ — they esteem, honor (?) (3mp imperfect; elsewhere 'lend'; sense uncertain here) (?)
glossary.ያፈቅሩከ: አፍቀረ — they will love you (3mp imperfect of the verb አፍቀረ, f-q-r, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ያፈቅሩኪ: አፍቀረ — they love you (3mp imperfect + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ይሁብ: ወሀበ — he gives (3ms imperfect, G, w-h-b)
glossary.ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይሜንኑ: መነነ — they despise (3mp imperfect, G, m-n-n)
glossary.ይርሕቁ: ርሕቀ — they are far, go far away (3mp imperfect, G, r-ḥ-q; intransitive)
glossary.ይሰባሕ: ሰብሐ — that it may be praised (3ms subjunctive, passive of ሰብሐ 'praise') (?)
glossary.ይተክል: ተከለ — he plants (3ms imperfect, G, t-k-l)
glossary.ይትመዐዕ: ተምዕዐ — he is angry (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, m-ʿ-ʿ)
glossary.ይትዔየሮ: ተዔየረ — he will reproach him (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, + -ዎ '3ms him'; stem not well known) (?)
glossary.ይኔጽሩ: ነጸረ — they look (at), regard (3mp imperfect, G, n-ṣ-r)
glossary.ይክል: ከህለ — he is able (3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l; with infinitive)
glossary.ይወፅእ: ወፅአ — he/it goes out (3ms imperfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይግእዞ: ገአዘ — he will restrain him, hold him back (3ms imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; stem uncertain) (?)
glossary.ይጸልኡ: ጸለአ — they hate (3mp imperfect, G, ṣ-l-ʾ)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ድኅሬኪ: ድኅሬ — behind you (noun/preposition ድኅሬ- 'back, behind' + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ገዓረነ: ገዓር — our cry (noun, 'outcry', from ገዐረ + -ነ '1cp our'; accusative) (?)
glossary.ጥቅመ: ጥቅም — [ṭəqmä] (?) unidentified (noun, accusative or construct; uncertain) · here probably 'help, benefit' (ኩንነ ጥቅመ 'be a help to us') (?)
glossary.ጥበቦ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem., accusative + -ኦ '3ms his')
glossary.ጸልዪ: ጸለየ — pray, intercede (2fs imperative, G, ṣ-l-y)
glossary.ፈታኔ: ፈታኒ — tester, examiner (agent noun of ፈተነ; ፈታኔ is the construct 'tester of')
glossary.፶፬: ፶፬ — 54, spoken ኀምሳ ወአርባዕቱ (ḫämsa wä-ʾärbaʿtu) 'fifty-four'; chapter number (numeral)
